# Licensing

There is no single license covering all repositories of this organization. **Licensing is decided on a per-repository basis**, and each repository states its own license in a `LICENSE` file in its root directory. If a repository has no `LICENSE` file, no permission to use, modify or redistribute its contents is granted.

## Choosing a license

For maintainers creating a new repository, KIT provides guidance on open source licensing for research software, including recommended licenses and the steps required at KIT:

👉 [KIT RSE Community – Open Source Licenses](https://www.rse-community.kit.edu/opensourcelicense.php)

Please follow this guidance when choosing a license for a repository, and add the chosen `LICENSE` file before the repository is made public.

## Contributions

Contributions to a repository are licensed under that repository's license. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/KIT-IWU-HydroEng/.github/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
